title: Skad
description: Skad ran with a mod gang in the mean streets of Mos Espa, stealing water and doing whatever was needed to survive. When Skad's crew got called out by Boba Fett for stealing water from a ruthless water monger, they had the choice to fight Fett or join him as his crew. Skad and the rest opted to join him. With his cybernetic eye as well as his left leg mod, Skad became a valuable player for Boba Fett, helping defend Mos Espa from the encroaching Pyke Syndicate.
